content: अतिसर्जनम् .²1 Giving, granting; consigning विधुरां ज्वलनातिसर्जनात् <ls>Ku. 4. 32</ls>, consigning to the flames; दीयतामिति वचोऽतिसर्जने <ls>Śi. 14. 48</ls>; तत्तदीयविशिखातिसर्जनात् <ls>Ki. 13. 57</ls> giving back. .²2 Liberality, munificence. .²3 Killing. .²4 Deception. .²5 Separation from, parting with.
